ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not in the aggregate exceed the charges payable for three (3) months of the terminated Services. IBM will refund to Customer any fees prepaid for the period after the effective date of termination on a pro-rata basis.

input.comment: [Playbook] We capped early termination charges at three months' fees and added a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since our playbook does not accept uncapped exit penalties on a convenience termination. The one month's notice period already works for us.
input.summary: Cap Section 3.4(b) early termination charges at three months' fees and require pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
